title: Allow record-keeping writes between issues in enforce_gate.py

verified_files.detail: Added is_record_keeping_path (prefix-anchored at directory boundaries, refuses '../') and read_target_path (argv first, stdin never read when argv supplies a path). main() now delegates to both.
Grew from 7 to 15 tests covering the exemption set, the rejected blanket *.md, repo-escape refusal, and the stdin hang regression.

design_decisions.decision: Exempt .solorail/, .claude/, .context/ and CLAUDE.md -- not a blanket '*.md'.
design_decisions.why: A blanket markdown exemption reads as harmless but would unlock README.md, every doc under a source tree, and any .md an issue's spec deliberately left off its allowlist. Documentation is often exactly what an issue is scoped to change, so it must stay gated. Test 2 exists to catch a future broadening.

design_decisions.decision: Record-keeping paths bypass the main/master block too.
design_decisions.why: Matches how .solorail/ already behaved. ADR-002 protects application code; a retro or scratch note is not that, and blocking it would make /solorail:evolve unusable on main.

design_decisions.decision: Prefixes matched at directory boundaries, and '../' refused.
design_decisions.why: '.contextual/' must not inherit the '.context' exemption, and an absolute path outside the repo (which normalizes to '../..') must never be silently exempt.

design_decisions.decision: argv is read before stdin, and stdin is skipped entirely when argv has a path.
design_decisions.why: Reading stdin unconditionally made the gate hang forever when invoked with a path from a context whose stdin was an open pipe -- json.load just waits. This cost a killed 120s command earlier in this epic.

definition_of_done.criterion: All new tests pass; full suite green
With no issue IN_PROGRESS, .context/ is writable and a non-allowlisted source file is still blocked
enforce_gate.py returns immediately with an open pipe on stdin
definition_of_done.evidence: Three invocations with stdin=/dev/zero each returned in under 0.05s; previously this hung until killed

definition_of_done.criterion: A path outside the repository root is not exempt

definition_of_done.evidence: is_record_keeping_path returns False for both. NOTE: the end-to-end check on README.md initially returned 0 -- see defect_found_during_verification; it is gated by this function, but a separate pre-existing hole let it through.

defect_found_during_verification.what: enforce_gate.py's allowlist check is a plain substring match against the entire spec file (`rel_path not in spec_content and basename not in spec_content`), so any filename merely MENTIONED in a spec's prose becomes writable.
defect_found_during_verification.how_found: This spec's own prose argues against a blanket *.md exemption using the words 'would unlock README.md'. That sentence silently allowlisted README.md, and the end-to-end verification of README.md returned exit 0 instead of 2.
defect_found_during_verification.severity: A spec that discusses a file in prose -- a risk note, a no-go list, a rationale -- grants write access to it. The no-go list is especially perverse: naming a file as forbidden makes it writable.
defect_found_during_verification.status: Declared as a loose end. The allowlist-matching logic was explicitly in this issue's no-go list, so it needs its own issue with a real allowlist-section parser.
defect_found_during_verification.verification_workaround: Re-verified using scripts/eval_metrics.py, confirmed absent from this spec, which correctly exits 2.

defects_closed: Between sprints everything outside .solorail/ was read-only, so the post-sprint status review could not be written to .context/ and a /tmp fallback was also refused
enforce_gate.py hung forever when invoked with a path as argv while stdin was an open non-tty pipe (previously logged as a loose end)
notes: This issue widens the gate, so every exemption is explicit and tested. The substring-matching hole found during verification is the more serious of the two gate weaknesses now known and should be prioritised over ISS-08.
